content: NestJS JWT auth: dual-token pattern - short-lived stateless access JWT + long-lived refresh token persisted (hashed) in DB for revocability. Two Passport strategies (AccessTokenStrategy, RefreshTokenStrategy) + two guards (AccessTokenGuard, RefreshTokenGuard extending AuthGuard). AuthModule wires PassportModule + JwtModule + PrismaModule; controller/service/dto/guard/strategy/decorator/interface folder split is the production-ready convention.
